blockers.name: real_training_not_started

blockers.evidence: No trained adapter checkpoint has been evaluated on held-out full_low or empty_high with visual and lift-hold metrics.

allowed_next_routes.description: Use the same source gates to collect any remaining ordinary cells while keeping held-out full_low and empty_high reserved for evaluation, but do not treat this as the active blocker for learned residual-adapter runner design.

Run the actual trainer with RUN_MODE=train only after confirming the GPU-utilization plan. The run must consume data/processed/residual_adapter_training_preflight_v1_20260627/manifest.json, rerun official Newton sanity, preserve held-out split checks, train for at least one GPU-hour, and write metrics/report/checkpoint paths without T-Rex schema promotion.
If using diffusion policy, ACT, OpenPI, or another serious baseline, first audit official code/checkpoints and observation/action contracts.
